description: Private seed: deployment-specific rules that must never ship in the repository. Copy to presets/private.json (gitignored) and edit. seed.mjs reads it if present and skips it otherwise.

rules.value: Replace with your own owner identifiers (account id / openid). Only this identity may request operation-level actions.
Replace with your own ambient reply policy, e.g. 'unaddressed group messages are answered with probability p'.
Optional: your own scoring scheme for regulars. Leave absent if you do not track this.
